summary: Elevate your customer service expertise with our specialized transport and logistics training course. Enroll now to provide top-notch care in the industry.
lede: Customer care in transport and logistics focuses on clear, responsive service when shipment delays, complaints or other exceptions arise. For customer service representatives, logistics coordinators and transport supervisors, it covers complaint triage, ETA updates, escalation pathways and CRM case tracking. Practical exercises include mapping customer journeys, drafting response scripts and building a service scorecard or improvement plan.
audienceIntro: This course is built for people who manage service interactions inside transport, freight, warehousing, delivery, and logistics support environments, where the quality of customer care depends on accurate communication, fast escalation, and disciplined follow-through.
modules: Transport and Logistics Customer Care Foundations
prerequisites: You should bring recent experience from transport, freight, warehousing, dispatch, or customer service roles. A laptop is recommended for templates and analytics exercises, and familiarity with CRM screens, complaint records, or service logs will make the applied work more useful.
